faces.name: Dire Undercurrents
faces.oracleText:
Whenever a blue creature you control enters, you may have target player draw a card.
Whenever a black creature you control enters, you may have target player discard a card.

faces.name: Dire Wolf Prowler
faces.oracleText: {1}{G}: This creature gets +2/+2 and gains haste until end of turn. Activate only once each turn.

faces.name: Dire Wolves
faces.oracleText: This creature has banding as long as you control a Plains. (Any creatures with banding, and up to one without, can attack in a band. Bands are blocked as a group. If any creatures with banding you control are blocking or being blocked by a creature, you divide that creature's combat damage, not its controller, among any of the creatures it's being blocked by or is blocking.)
